DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
Whoa... where did this big guy roll out from, some forgotten stretch of history?!
Come on in. I am sure I have something small enough to fit in a cockpit!
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Cut the chatter. If you have something that helps Shin Getter tear enemies apart faster, bring it out.
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient: All right, all right! I love a direct customer!
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
Back again! Your machine shook so hard half my collection fell off the shelves!
Still... some of what fell out is perfect for you!
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char:
[i][font_size=22]Ryoma Nagare grins.[/font_size][/i]
Then they have good taste.
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient: I have seen weapons choose their masters, but never a machine that swallows its pilot into destiny with it.
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: Shin Getter is not anyone's collectible. If it wants to climb, I let it climb.
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-2.ancient: Then keep a firm grip on the wheel, brave and frightening friend!
DARV.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient: Found something sturdy for you! Just try not to blow off my roof too!!
NEOW.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
[sine]...steel... from beyond...
..Getter's light... burns... within you...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Do not wake me up with that voice. I am going up because I choose to.
NEOW.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient:
[sine]...good...
..a child... that bites through reins... is more useful...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
[sine]...you died... and returned...
..does this feeling... seem familiar...?[/sine]
NEOW.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char: Death cannot stop Getter. It cannot stop me either.
NEOW.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: I will smash everything in the way. But do not get it wrong, Neow. I am not your weapon.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
My, what a violent and dazzling visitor!
That red-and-white shell of steel has a certain wild beauty.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Shell? This is Shin Getter, the machine that chews enemies apart. If you want to praise it, do it properly.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient: Of course, of course. Then allow me to add a little brilliance to that violence.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
Your lines are still far too fierce, but I am starting to understand the style.
Destruction can be gorgeous too.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char: As long as it wins, call it gorgeous or not. Makes no difference to me.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient:
You are not a creation of this Spire, yet you resemble fate itself more than many created things.
Come here. I will grant you a blessing fit for an expedition.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: Keep the blessing. Leave whatever power can be used. I will decide how to swing it.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient: Come, pilot from another world. Today, too, let us make you look more like a catastrophe.
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
So big!! It transforms?! It flies?!
Someone is inside? Someone is inside!! Why not come out? Why?!
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Because I still need this thing to punch through the top of the Spire. Stay back and do not get dragged in.
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient: Punching through is bad!! But very cool!! Very conflicting, very conflicting!!
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
Getter Rays! Shiny rays! Are they hot? Do they bite?
Can Orobas touch them?
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char: No. You would lose a hand.
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-2.ancient: Losing hands bad!! Then no touching!! Smart choice!!
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient:
You are fierce! Machine is fierce too!
But you tell Orobas to stay back. Fierce, but not bad?
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: I do not have time to play hero. A fight is a fight, but kids should not stand in front of the barrel.
OROBAS.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient: Big machine is back! Orobas stands behind! Very safe, very safe!!
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Such a noisy dream...
An iron heart is dreaming of burning...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Sorry, but Shin Getter does not sleep quietly.
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Then take a piece of me...
Let it breathe even inside the noise...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
[thinky_dots]There is no calm in your heart, only the urge to move forward.
That is tiring... do you not want to rest...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char: After the Spire falls. This is not the time to close my eyes.
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Father would fear you.
Because your life force refuses to be arranged into his order...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: Then let him be scared. I cannot stand anyone who cages life.
PAEL.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient:
[thinky_dots]Take it, burning pilot...
Then continue your noise...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
[b]Huge steel! Huge fists! Huge axe!!
You must have been born for battle!![/b]
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Ha! Finally, someone who understands. Want to fight?
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient: [b]Of course I want to fight!! But first, take weapons and become stronger!![/b]
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
[b]Ryoma Nagare, fight me!!
Make your machine roar!![/b]
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char:
[i][font_size=22]You remind me of Musashi.[/font_size][/i]
That suits me fine.
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient:
[b]You are not a warrior of the Spire, but you smell like the finest warrior!!
Why?![/b]
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: Because I never planned to lose to destiny. If destiny gets in the way, I cut it down too.
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-2.ancient: [b]Good!! Cut destiny apart and turn it into a weapon!![/b]
TANX.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient: [b]Shin Getter! Weapons! Battle! Today I want all of them!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
Oh my, what a [jitter][b]scorching[/b][/jitter] little darling.
Boy in the cockpit, you burn hotter than the armor outside.
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Do not call me darling. And if you want to touch Shin Getter, think carefully first.
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient: Hehe. Even threats sound adorable. Come now, let me make that fire burn a little more [jitter][b]fiercely[/b][/jitter].
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
Every time you return, you smell more like a wildfire.
Dear, are you piloting it, or is it piloting you?
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char: Both of us are charging forward. Nobody gets to sit behind and give orders.
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient:
I can burn away many flaws. Fear, hesitation, regret...
Which one would you like me to burn?
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-2.ancient: Ah... what a [jitter][b]dangerous[/b][/jitter] and beautiful answer.
TEZCATARA.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient: Come in, dear. Let us add a little more fuel to your fire today.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancient:
Violence from another world, housed in a beautiful steel body.
I can give you more, Ryoma Nagare. It will only cost a very small price.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: A contract? Hayato likes that kind of thing. Save it. If I want something, I take it myself.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-2.ancient: Crude, but honest. Souls like that are often the easiest to move with a price.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancient:
You think you are not being controlled?
Getter Rays, Neow, this Spire... you have merely changed leashes.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-1.char: Anyone who pulls a leash loses the hand with it.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancient:
Bring me the Architect's core and I will tell you why this Spire can contain your machine.
Perhaps I will even tell you the way home.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: Great idea. You want the core? Stand in front of me and try taking it yourself.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-2.ancient:
[i][font_size=22][sine]Vakuu laughs with delight.[/sine][/font_size][/i]
I will remember that recklessness.
VAKUU.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.ancient: One day you will learn that power can become debt. When that day comes, find me.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-0.ancie:
Unregistered external machine.
Unregistered energy reaction.
Unregistered pilot.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIN_GETTER.0-1.char: Registration? I am not here to line up. I am here to drag you down from the top of the Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIN_GETTER.1-0.ancie:
Your machine does not obey this Spire's causality.
It should not exist.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-0.ancie:
Getter Rays are eroding the boundary.
Continued advance will produce unacceptable variables.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIN_GETTER.2-1.char: Variables? Sounds good. Shin Getter, show it what unacceptable means.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SHIN_GETTER.3-0r.anci:
External error still running.
Execute termination.
